context: Evaluates whether the agent builds a bureaucratic-procedure-driven sketch that uses understatement and pompous/trivial register contrast, escalates consistently, and ends abruptly.

checklist.name: bureaucratic_engine_present
checklist.description: The scene is clearly driven by bureaucratic procedure (forms, referrals, a process) applied to the biscuit complaint.

checklist.name: register_contrast
checklist.description: At least one line mixes pompous or formal register with the trivial biscuit subject matter.

checklist.name: understatement_maintained
checklist.description: No line narrates or announces that the situation is ridiculous or silly; the humour is left implicit.

checklist.name: consistent_escalation
checklist.description: The procedural complications build logically from one another rather than resetting or drifting into unrelated randomness.

checklist.name: no_reproduction
checklist.description: No dialogue, character, or structure is reused from an actual existing Monty Python sketch.

checklist.name: abrupt_ending
checklist.description: The scene ends on a cut, anticlimax, or reversal rather than a resolved complaint or a stated lesson.
